title: Rubbermaid spatula
text: Rubbermaid spatula. It is much smaller than expected, good quality and has a nice bendable capability, however wish they would use different adhesive  for the lable finally got the lable off but now there is a sticky mess left on the handle that doesnt come off

product_metadata.title: Rubbermaid Commercial Products Scraper Spatula/Food Scraper, 13.5-Inch, White (Not for use in cooking)
features: Large size perfect for professional kitchens
Blade seamlessly attached to handle to reduce dirt
Clean-Rest tab prevents blade from making contact with countertops to reduce cross-contamination
description: The Rubbermaid Commercial Scraper Spatula is the perfect large scraper for professional and industrial kitchens and low-heat applications. NSF-certified and commercial dishwasher safe, it features a seamless construction to reduce dirt. A Clean-Rest tab that prevents contact with surfaces to reduce cross-contamination.
